name: terse
description: Three skills you invoke to assess and improve a standalone text: `audit` measures it, `rethink` agrees its shape, and `rewrite` writes it. `clarity` is reader-side guidance Claude may choose while writing an answer, plan, commit, PR, comment, message, or agent brief; it starts no agents. The deep skills use agents, work in a run directory and ask before applying a text to your files.
